Hey Everyone,

Let’s see what happend during the last week or two in A.I. I hope you find something to read of interest here. You can also just skim the link titles and get some general idea if you are pressed for time. You ready for a lot of links?

a16z

What GenAI web Product consumer trends can we see now in September, 2023?

Here are the top 6 takeaways according to a16z:

1. Most leading products are built from the “ground up” around generative AI

2. ChatGPT has a massive lead, for now… (Character.AI and Pi have momentum, with Gemini coming soon). 

3. LLM assistants (like ChatGPT) are dominant, but companionship and creative tools are on the rise (e.g. Pi, Poe as a gateway, character.ai) 

4. Early “winners” have emerged, but most product categories are up for grabs

5. Acquisition for top products is entirely organic—and consumers are willing to pay! (i.e. Paid subscriptions) 

6. Mobile apps are still emerging as a GenAI platform (the trend is ‘generative’ to ‘interactive’)
